scenes.title: The problem
scenes.visual: the textured auto build orbiting (recording 17-30 s) with the title block over it
scenes.animation: title block fades in, then out before the next scene
scenes.narration: A scan of a plant room looks real, but it is blind. It does not know where the pumps are, or what a pipe is. Approve-to-Build Twin gives it that meaning.

scenes.title: One room, built twice
scenes.visual: both builds coloured by origin, orbiting (recording 4-16 s)
scenes.animation: two chips slide in: cyan MANUAL 28, amber AUTO 530
scenes.narration: The same room, built twice. Cyan: a person approved 28 parts one by one, each decision photographed. Amber: the machine alone found 530 objects in about an hour.

chips.text: MANUAL · 28 parts · a person approves each one
AUTO · 530 objects · the machine alone, ~1 h

scenes.title: The live viewer
scenes.visual: orbiting the textured room, hovering a pipe (recording 22-34 s)
scenes.animation: URL chip, then a small line about the detail levels
scenes.narration: This is the live viewer at twinbuild.click: the scan streams coarse first, in five detail levels. Orbit it, click any part.

headline: Live at twinbuild.click
props.sub: 5 detail levels · coarse first · desktop, phone, Quest 3

scenes.title: Play the build
scenes.visual: the build slider at 0, play pressed, the automatic build grows (recording 57.5-64 s)
scenes.animation: spotlight on the play button and the counter
scenes.narration: Press play to replay the automatic build, object by object.

scenes.title: Click any object
scenes.visual: three cuts: step ladder card (68 s), trolley (203 s), exit sign (248 s)
scenes.animation: spotlight on the part card; three quick cuts
scenes.narration: Click a step ladder, a trolley, even the exit sign. Each card shows size, confidence, pictures, and the nearest parts with distances.

scenes.title: Measure
scenes.visual: measuring between two points on the scan: 2.357 u ≈ 2.71 m (recording 314-319 s)
on_screen_text: Measure between any two points: 2.36 u ≈ 2.71 m
scenes.narration: Or measure between any two points.

scenes.title: The manual build
scenes.visual: Manual pressed (318 s), then Pump 1 with its approval images (333-345 s)
scenes.animation: spotlight on the approval images, then zoom on them
scenes.narration: The manual build keeps the audit trail: Pump 1, accepted at step 447, with its approval pictures right on the card. The proposal in green, the room in its own colours.

scenes.title: Both builds compared
scenes.visual: both builds in red/grey with the comparison panel; an automatic pipe selected (recording 360.5-375 s)
on_screen_text: 417 objects the person never got to
scenes.animation: spotlight on the comparison summary in the panel
scenes.narration: Both builds in one room, compared: the machine finds 23 of the 28 approved parts, and adds 417 objects the person never got to.

scenes.title: Why it matters
scenes.visual: the by-origin room orbiting, dimmed, with three value lines
scenes.animation: three value lines reveal one by one
scenes.narration: Human-approved parts, machine-scale coverage, and a picture for every decision. A scan that can finally tell you what is this, and where. Open it at twinbuild.click.

scenes.title: End card
scenes.visual: end card: title, URL, built-with chips
